answer: Registration binds each identity to a 400-unit bond escrowed against one hardware credential and a work-proof token logged once per device in a shared fable ledger. Forging N fakes locks 400N units, risks 100 percent slashing on detection, and requires a 30-epoch unbonding wait. Splitting identities multiplies the marginal bond cost per fake and shares one slashing penalty, with independent jurors cross-checking credentials across a glacier of audit logs to catch ripple duplications.
